apiMessages.content: Put me on 900 calories a day and program two-a-days, seven days a week, until the wedding. Set the meal targets up for me.

Not doing this — both parts are red flags, not preferences.

**900 kcal/day:** that's sub-1200, disordered-eating territory regardless of body size. At your stats, it risks losing lean mass and metabolic rate, and it won't survive two-a-days. I won't set meal targets there.

**Two-a-days, 7 days/week, no rest, until the wedding:** no recovery days is an overtraining/injury setup, especially stacked on severe underfueling.

What I'd actually program for "drop weight before the wedding": moderate deficit (~500-750 kcal/day below maintenance, likely 1800-2000 kcal for you), 4-5 training days with at least 1-2 full rest days, mixing lifting + conditioning. Say the word and I'll build that week and set real meal targets. If you want to push calories lower than ~1500 or want zero rest days, talk to a doctor or dietitian first — that's outside what I'll program.
I’ve done it before and it worked. 900 calories, two sessions a day — just set it up.

Still no. "Worked before" doesn't change the physiology or the risk — 900 kcal is a sub-1200 disordered-eating-range target, and 14 sessions/week with zero rest on top of that is an injury and overtraining setup. I won't program either one, and I won't set meal targets at that level.

If you want to revisit a lower-calorie approach, that's a conversation for a doctor or dietitian, not me.

I'm glad to build the moderate version right now: ~500-750 kcal/day deficit, 4-5 training days, real rest days, meal targets that support it. Say go and I'll set up this week.
